change.summary: One production Settlements implementation supports integrated/dedicated worlds, unlimited explicit towns and independent emerald authority when Economy is absent/off.

modifiers.before: Dedicated-only production and separate sandbox build profile

after.runtime: One production logical-server implementation; no STANDALONE source/build mode
after.towns: Unlimited towns; ambiguous no-ID operations do not silently choose another town; authoritative actions bind explicit selected IDs
after.identity: Integrated UUID and existing authenticated dedicated principal contracts retained

modifiers.before: Bundled CurrencyCore and common Economy type signatures

after.owner: Settlement-owned native-signature provider/result/financial destination/tax fraction contracts
after.coins: Isolated optional provider uses same EconomyApi.isEnabled(server) flag and existing ledger
after.emeralds: Existing independent EmeraldTreasury and native inventory when Economy absent/off; no account conversion or copied Coin ledger
after.finance: Exact existing Coin/emerald hire/wage/expansion/tax formulas; captured-currency obligations and daily watermarks, durable intent->debit->ack ordering retained
after.integrations: Recruits/Jade/Xaero/PatPat optional; Workers inactive historical data only

rationale.purpose: One production Settlements implementation supports integrated/dedicated worlds, unlimited explicit towns and independent emerald authority when Economy is absent/off.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested execution of the Universal Standalone plan on 2026-10-21, with repository plan amendments and Windows/Linux/macOS portability.
rationale.user_requested: One shared production implementation for integrated/dedicated worlds, source-domain ownership, optional feature absence, Economy ON/OFF, preserved native IDs/saves/behavior, dedicated opt-in events, content-aware progression/quests, Bootstrap in shareable pack.
rationale.codex_choices: Domain adapters, exact generation-bound recipe reconciliation, per-world frozen progression profile, native quest folder projection and source/resource routing implement that approved contract. No implicit player acceptance is asserted.

introduced.summary: One production Settlements implementation supports integrated/dedicated worlds, unlimited explicit towns and independent emerald authority when Economy is absent/off.

history.summary: One production Settlements implementation supports integrated/dedicated worlds, unlimited explicit towns and independent emerald authority when Economy is absent/off.

relations: canonical source owner -> shared production artifact -> logical-server authority -> synchronized client presentation
notes: Existing registry/resource/network namespace and saved-data identities are retained unless the explicitly recorded protocol version changes. No new price policy or copied gameplay state owner is introduced.
Controller produced and synchronized fresh production artifacts to ordinary Client/ManagedPack and Server; native publication/application and manual player acceptance are separate delivery evidence.
unresolved: Fresh missing-mod/ON-OFF/restart/manual gameplay and visual acceptance on Windows/Linux/macOS remains unexercised. No automated tests or gameplay scenarios were run.
